Learning resources

Source: vignettes/learning-resources.Rmd
learning-resources.Rmd

These resources provide background on personalized medicine, treatment-effect prediction and the methods used in precmed.

Handbook

For a broader introduction to personalized medicine using real-world data, see Comparative Effectiveness and Personalized Medicine Research Using Real-World Data (Debray et al. 2026). The following chapters are particularly relevant to precmed:

  • Chapter 5: marginal and conditional treatment effects, including the ATE (Nguyen et al. 2026).
  • Chapter 17: principles of CATE prediction and model development in randomized and non-randomized data (Hoogland et al. 2026).
  • Chapter 19: validation strategies and assessment of discrimination, calibration, and decision accuracy (Thao et al. 2026).
  • Chapter 20: visualization and interpretation of individualized treatment rules, validation curves, and responder diagnostics, with examples using precmed (Jiang et al. 2026).

Free courses

These free courses can help you build the knowledge and practical skills needed to study personalized treatment decisions. An Introduction to Precision Medicine introduces the foundations through recorded webinars, exercises, and readings. The companion course to the book provides background materials, example R code, and curated references to support practical analyses with precmed and related methods.

Methodological references

The original methodological references are Yadlowsky et al. (2021) for ratio-based CATE estimation and validation, and Zhao et al. (2013) for target-population selection.
